method: Every original sample retained. Per-cell automation wallclock median is the existing five-run gate metric. Descriptive nearest-rank stage p50/p95 use every recorded stage occurrence; missing stages are explicit, never zero-filled. No pooling of the two runs.
limitations: Five samples do not establish a stable p95. Browser stages are paint-opportunity proxies, not physical same-frame proof.
Database observedAt is not asserted to be exact capture completion; completion stays null if unrecorded.
This summary is not activation or Phase0 acceptance. Canonical artifact binding and all other release gates remain separate.

protocol.sheetCost: Outer wallclock includes sheet-open click, any readiness wait, verified pinch and final PDF coverage. Browser stage marks are dispatch-to-sampled-ready measures, not same-frame proof.
